label: Town of Middlesex
header:
# Town of Middlesex municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 14; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Town of Middlesex (official website), Administration page (the town's maintained officials directory): seats the five selectboard members: Liz Scharf (Chair), Zara Vincent (Vice Chair), Paul Cerminara, Stacey Skadberg, and Larry Rooney; the surname is Cerminara per the town

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists Middlesex's selectboard as Elizabeth Scharf, Paul Cerminara, Lawrence Rooney, Stacey Skadberg, and Zara Vincent -- the directory's full forms of the town page's Liz Scharf and Larry Rooney are recorded

Town of Middlesex (official website), Administration page (the town's maintained officials directory): states the Town Clerk 'is elected at Town Meeting for a three-year term' and names Brigid Browning

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town clerk contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): lists Brigid Browning as Middlesex's town clerk -- the June 2026 spreadsheet governs over the January 2026 Guide's Cheryl Grandfield, who is now the treasurer

Town of Middlesex (official website), Administration page (the town's maintained officials directory): states the Town Treasurer 'is elected at Town Meeting to a one-year term' and names Cheryl Grandfield
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town treasurer contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): lists Cheryl Grandfield as Middlesex's town treasurer
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): names Cheryl Grandfield as Middlesex's town treasurer
Town of Middlesex (official website), Administration page (the town's maintained officials directory): names Cheryl Grandfield Collector of Delinquent Taxes (elected, one-year term)

Town of Middlesex (official website), Administration page (the town's maintained officials directory): states 'three listers, one elected each year for staggered three-year terms' and names Samantha Beaudoin, Shelley DesJardin, and Sean McVeigh (Sean McVeigh the lister is not Chris McVeigh the justice of the peace)

Town of Middlesex (official website), Administration page (the town's maintained officials directory): states the Budget Committee's 'five members are elected to staggered three-year terms' and names Mark Harris (Chair), Samantha Beaudoin, Dorinda Crowell, Elias Gardner, and Zara Vincent. The same page records that Middlesex voters have chosen to use a professional outside auditor, so no auditor post exists
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists six Middlesex justices of the peace elected November 5, 2024
Town of Middlesex (official website), Administration page (the town's maintained officials directory): the page's partial justice block concurs on Crowell, Demeter, Chris McVeigh, and Thouron

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists six Middlesex justices of the peace elected November 5, 2024: Dorinda Crowell, Jan Thouron, Chris McVeigh, Mary Just Skinner, John Demeter, and Tammy McCullough. The listing publishes no vote totals or party labels and none are recorded
